generalProvisions: This bill addresses economic development planning and programs within the Governor's Office of Economic Development.
highlightedProvisions: This bill:<hr><ltbullet>defines terms and modifies definitions;<hr><ltbullet>renames the Governor's Office of Economic Opportunity to the Governor's Office of Economic Development;<hr><ltbullet>exempts the Governor's Office of Economic Development from procurement requirements related to the correctional industries division;<hr><ltbullet>modifies the duties of the executive director of the Governor's Office of Economic Development (executive director);<hr><ltbullet>establishes the Economic Development Council (council);<hr><ltbullet>describes the membership of the council;<hr><ltbullet>describes the duties of the council;<hr><ltbullet>establishes reporting requirements for the council;<hr><ltbullet>requires reports to the Economic Development and Workforce Services Interim Committee;<hr><ltbullet>includes a coordination clause; and<hr><ltbullet>makes technical and conforming changes.
